title: Task Mode and Product Link Fix

sections.name: Checkout
items: Checkout now repairs incomplete Pokémon Center links and opens the exact SKU product page.
A reused harvester only keeps its current product page when that page matches the task SKU.

sections.name: Webhooks
items: The Mode field now reflects the task's actual mode.
Product links now use the corrected SKU-bearing Pokémon Center URL.

instructions: Open Brava, go to Settings, check for updates, then select Update & restart.
